instruction.text: What is a stranger? Fill in the gaps.

atoms.b: A stranger is someone that you ((++do_not already)) know.
Strangers are ((++not_always very)) bad, but it is important to be careful around them.
In certain situations, you may need to communicate with strangers - for example, if you get lost. It is important to ask a ((++safer dangerous)) stranger for help.
Safer strangers will often wear a ((++uniform cloak)) and a name badge.

atoms.a: a random person in the park

trainers.instruction: Select the safer of the two strangers.

feedback.end: If you cannot find a safer stranger wearing a uniform, you could also try to find a family with children to help you.

instruction.text: If you cannot find any safer strangers, it is important to try and find a safer building. Drag each building to the correct group.

hint.text: Select an image to hear what it is.

feedback.wrong: You must never follow a stranger to their house, even if they seem friendly.
